_comment: A Pterodactyl egg for one dot-server. Import under Nests > a nest > Import Egg. Every setting is an environment variable because ./server takes all of them that way -- see deploy/env.example. rcon_password is deliberately NOT a variable here: it is a secret, and Pterodactyl both displays variables in the panel and puts them in the container environment, where any process in the container can read them. It goes in cfg/rcon.yml, which is a file with a mode on it.
name: dot-server
author: noreply@anthropic.com
description: A dot-server running one game out of its content directory. The bhop/surf timer, the deathmatch, the sandbox and the lobby all ship in one build; TMC_GAME picks which one boots, and it can be changed live over RCON without a restart.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Installs a dot-server into /mnt/server.
#
# Godot is fetched here rather than baked into the image so the runtime version is
# a panel variable: this tree tracks Godot closely, and an egg pinned to an image
# tag goes stale the week the engine moves.
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends git curl unzip ca-certificates >/dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# --- the runtime -------------------------------------------------------------
GODOT_VERSION="${GODOT_VERSION:-4.7.2-stable}"
GODOT_ZIP="Godot_v${GODOT_VERSION}_linux.x86_64.zip"
GODOT_URL="https://github.com/godotengine/godot/releases/download/${GODOT_VERSION}/${GODOT_ZIP}"

echo "[install] godot ${GODOT_VERSION}"
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/godot.zip "$GODOT_URL"
unzip -oq /tmp/godot.zip -d /tmp/godot
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.runtime
find /tmp/godot -type f -name 'Godot_v*' -exec mv {} /mnt/server/.runtime/godot ';'
chmod +x /mnt/server/.runtime/godot

# --- the server --------------------------------------------------------------
# A shallow clone: the history of this repository is of no use on a game box and
# is most of the download.
REPO="${DEPLOY_REPO:-https://github.com/modcommunity/dot-server-deploy.git}"
BRANCH="${DEPLOY_BRANCH:-main}"

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "[install] updating an existing checkout"
    git fetch --depth 1 origin "$BRANCH"
    git reset --hard "origin/$BRANCH"
else
    echo "[install] cloning $REPO ($BRANCH)"
    git clone --depth 1 --branch "$BRANCH" "$REPO" /tmp/deploy
    # Copied rather than cloned in place: /mnt/server is not empty by the time this
    # runs -- the runtime above is already in it -- and git clone refuses that.
    cp -a /tmp/deploy/. /mnt/server/
    rm -rf /tmp/deploy
fi

# --- vendor, and write ./server ----------------------------------------------
# setup.sh bakes the runtime path it FINDS into ./server, so it has to see ours.
export PATH="/mnt/server/.runtime:$PATH"
export GODOT="/mnt/server/.runtime/godot"

chmod +x setup.sh
./setup.sh

echo
echo "[install] done. cfg/ holds the YAML; put rcon_password in cfg/rcon.yml."

variables.name: Game
variables.description: Which game in content/ boots. g2gfast is the bhop/surf timer. Also in this build: arena, playground, lobby, hungry_classic.

variables.name: Port
variables.description: The game port. RCON is always this plus one, so two servers a single port apart collide on RCON and nowhere else -- leave a gap of at least 2.

variables.name: Bind address
variables.description: Interface to bind. 0.0.0.0 is every one, which is what a container wants.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Shown in listings and in the browser client.

variables.name: Godot version
variables.description: The runtime tag fetched at install, as it appears in the engine's own release URLs. Changing it needs a reinstall.

variables.name: Deploy repository
variables.description: Where the server is cloned from at install.

variables.name: Deploy branch
variables.description: Branch to check out at install.

variables.name: Verbose logging
variables.description: Set to 1 for debug logging. Empty for normal.
